scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you help me with that?
dialogue.agent: I can certainly help with that. Your application for a conventional refinancing loan in the amount of $145,000 has been denied.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what was the interest rate that was considered for my application?
dialogue.agent: The primary reason for the denial of your loan application was a debt-to-income ratio of 45%. The record does not include the interest rate that was considered for your application.

dialogue.user: I understand. A 45% debt-to-income ratio is indeed quite high. Were there any other factors that contributed to the denial? Also, do you know if my loan application was flagged as a high-cost or negative amortization loan?
dialogue.agent: No, there were no other factors that contributed to the denial of your loan application. This loan was not flagged as a high-cost or negative amortization loan.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for the information. I think that's all I needed to know for now.

<Neutral> - The agent provided the necessary information about the denial of my loan application and the reason behind it. However, I was hoping to get more details on the interest rate and any other factors that might have contributed to the decision. Overall, the interaction was satisfactory but could have been more thorough.
